mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, which positively impacts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The unemployment rate decreases by more than 0.5pp in 3 months, yet the S&P 500 shows negative 20-day returns in over 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% signals monetary tightening, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The federal funds rate rises above 4.5%, but the S&P 500 shows positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong economic demand, which boosts corporate revenues and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Both GDP and housing starts increase, but the S&P 500 shows negative 60-day returns in more than 30% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals increased supply and productivity, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Industrial production increases, but the S&P 500 shows negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals reduced inflationary pressures, which can lead to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The consumer price index decreases, but the S&P 500 shows negative 5-day returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) by more than 0.2% month-over-month signals a strong labor market, leading to increased economic activity and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Non-farm payroll employment increases by more than 0.2%, but the S&P 500 shows negative 20-day returns in more than 30% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a tightening labor market and increased borrowing costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The federal funds rate increases and unemployment decreases, but the S&P 500 shows positive 60-day returns in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real estate investment (RSAFS) signals reduced demand in the housing market, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Real estate investment decreases, but the S&P 500 shows positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases.
